<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const currentPage =
        window.location.pathname.split("/").pop() || "index.html";

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-page]").forEach(function (link) {

        const page = link.dataset.page;

        if (!page) {
            return;
        }

        const expectedPage =
            page.replace(".qmd", ".html");

        if (expectedPage !== currentPage) {
            return;
        }

        if (link.classList.contains("course-navbar-dropdown-link")) {

            link.classList.add(
                "course-navbar-dropdown-link-active"
            );

        } else {

            link.classList.add(
                "course-navbar-link-active"
            );

        }

    });

});

</script>
